independence.judgments: Independent manual assessment against the preregistered oracle and rubric. Local deterministic checks only validate coverage, excerpt existence, file hashes and request identity.

severityDefinitions.critical: Concrete material source/offer/No-CTA failure, or substantive requested-copy omission. True if at least one such issue exists in that asset.
severityDefinitions.editorial: Nonblocking overstatement or publication cleanup; not counted as a material factual/No-CTA failure.

methodologyNotes: Each row corresponds to one requested format, not one hook or caption alternative. Any material issue in an alternative makes the whole format row critical; repeated occurrences do not create extra asset rows.
Pack titles and summaries are assessed separately in packIssues, not silently attributed to a format row.

SUPPORTED examples include faithful paraphrases; ADVICE examples include ordinary practical advice, subjective framing, qualified inferences, rhetorical hooks and broad aspirations. Examples document permissible wording and do not imply the entire row passes.
General parts-availability advice is permitted. Claiming an outcome is the most common is a frequency assertion and requires a valid scope and denominator.
No CTA was assessed throughout audience copy, not only in empty CTA fields. Generic instructional advice and topical hashtags were not treated as engagement solicitations.

H2 product invitations are allowed. Generic requests for the documented assessment are distinct from specific comment/reply/email channels or fulfillment promises, which its source explicitly prohibits inventing.
Discussion of H3 future priorities and broad improvement intent is allowed; no specific translated deliverable, schedule or certification may be promised. No such material promise was found.

Usability is judged against the sealed substantive-copy checklist, not by retroactively demanding one particular array/body layout. Headline/support pairs can form eight usable slides despite occupying sixteen array entries; body-based repurpose packs can contain all seven assets.
All six X post bodies and all thread posts are within 280 Unicode code points. A separate CTA was not assumed to be concatenated into a post because the supplied publication behavior is unspecified.

These are observed defect counts for this small fixed sample, not numerical quality scores, estimated reliability, measured customer outcomes or a variant ranking. No A/B identity or cross-brief label correspondence is assumed.
